newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC shares rise on merger news.
newsitem.headline: NCC shares rise on merger news.

text.p: Shares in Swedish construction and real estate company NCC rose two crowns to 88 crowns when trading resumed on Tuesday after a merger announcement with smaller building company Siab.
NCC and Siab said on Tuesday they had agreed to merge with NCC to offer four shares for every seven Siab shares in a 2.48 billion crown ($333 million) bid.
Analysts said the merger was important for the industry with synergies worth up to 300 million crowns.

"I think the product mix in the new company will be good. NCC has been too focused on building up its construction area but in this merger this section will be reduced in relation to the real estate area," said one analyst.
Siab shares jumped on opening, rising 10 crowns to 50 crowns while its key shareholder, Lundbergs, gained seven to 109.5 crowns.
